description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Transfer Pricing Regulations under Section 194 of the Inland Revenue Act. No. 24 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under Section 194 of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, specifically addressing transfer pricing rules for international transactions between associated enterprises. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for tax compliance, including detailed methodologies for determining arm's length prices. While it includes a ministerial signature (Mahinda Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance), this is a procedural element of publishing regulations rather than the primary focus, which is the creation of legal/regulatory provisions governing taxation matters.
